levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or both packing systems are not actually applied as described (items are not truly grouped by category, or not truly ordered by use).

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Both the category system and the order-of-use system are applied correctly and distinctly to the same set of real items.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner notices and names an item that was easy to forget during the initial lay-out step.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The comparison between systems is vague or unsupported ('one was better') with no specific evidence.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The comparison names a specific item and a real difference in how quickly or easily it was found under each system.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the reflection correctly reasons about why the chosen system fits this trip and names a different trip type where the other system would work better.

lookFors: The bag and items are real and tied to an actual upcoming trip or outing, not invented for the assignment.
The learner actually unpacks fully between the two packing attempts rather than only rearranging.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
